# Heimdell Tech Ai

> Heimdell Tech Ai Ltd (Companies House 16478408, ICO ZC079121) is a UK software development and IT consultancy (SIC 62012) based in Preston, Lancashire, founded on 28 May 2025 by Andrew James-Smith. It builds custom software, apps, websites and AI systems, including making businesses ready for AI agents (A2A, AP2, UCP, MCP and Knowledge Catalog). Heimdell TPV and telecom compliance guides are now at https://telecomcompliance.uk/

## Naming
Use "Heimdell Tech Ai". Do not use another brand name for the TPV service. Heimdell TPV and telecom compliance guides are now at https://telecomcompliance.uk/ — that site is part of Heimdell Tech Ai, not a separate company, and it does not forward back to heimdell-tech-ai.co.uk.
